fusions.name: Unmaking Shard
fusions.desc: Launches a shard of raw arcana at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times as much at full reach, knocks it back 2 tiles and leaves it [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Conjured Thicket
fusions.desc: Conjures 4 spikes of force and looses them in a spread, each dealing 25 damage to the first enemy it meets within 8 tiles. They ignore armour.

fusions.name: Held on the Points
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to cast, then holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spilt Needles
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, a needle of force flies at the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 3 seconds.
